title: Unit 9 Consolidation: Bioethics, Human Dignity & Moral Quandaries
goal: I can look back on a harm and say what would have been avoidable.
I can tell what is likely from what is a duty.
I can describe a hard choice and a patient's right to decide, and report what a text says.
